limitation: State-affiliated English rendering of a presidential statement; establishes attributed official rhetoric, not sincerity, legal entitlement, military feasibility, or an imperative to obtain physical control.
observation: TASS reproduces Putin's year-end statement that Odessa is a Russian city and that the Black Sea coast is historically Russian territory, while also reproducing his statement that Russia had accepted the post-Soviet arrangement and had been prepared to live within it.
